label: WRONG
reason: Every @Component class follows the suffix (app.component.ts, tag.component.ts, text.component.ts) and src-ui/eslint.config.js does not enable @angular-eslint/component-class-suffix, so not TRIVIAL; but the scope 'classes in *.component files' also covers a recurring kind of non-component class: plain selection/query model classes (filterable-dropdown.component.ts:62, permissions-filter-dropdown.component.ts:28, custom-fields-query-dropdown.component.ts:72) and permission base classes (with-permissions.component.ts, an undecorated class; loading.component.ts, an abstract @Directive) that 39 files extend. None is the rule's own definition or an aggregator, so per R1 they count, 0 of 5 are mistakes, and an agent co-locating a new model or base class would be told to name it *Component. Hesitated with ACCEPT, since the tool marks these exempt and a real component missing the suffix would be worth flagging.
